title: Stop Temporary Kit Persistence
description: Temporary kits in compose sketchpad must not be persisted. Reproduce and fix the compose/play path where kit changes are currently persisted. Extend existing tests only, and verify the relevant test suite passes.
summary: Stopped temporary kit browser snapshot persistence by filtering persisted kit snapshots to durable kinds only (file, folder, remote) on localStorage and IndexedDB reads/writes. Added an embedded sketchpad regression test proving legacy temporary snapshots are ignored and edited temporary kits write an empty browser snapshot instead of persisting kit data. Verification: focused regression test passed; adjacent persistence restore tests passed. Full sketchpad Playwright suite timed out after 10 minutes, and tsc --noEmit still reports existing unrelated sketchpad type errors.
